# MoYo Natural Labs 8 oz Fine Mist Spray Bottles (3-Pack, Multi-Color)

## Built to Last

These 8-ounce bottles are crafted from BPA-free PET plastic and made in the USA. The sturdy construction handles frequent refills, so you replace them less often and save money over time.

## Fine Mist for Everyday Use

The sprayer releases a light, even mist for essential oils, colognes, floral waters, serums, and hair products. Its no-leak design helps keep formulas contained in your bag, so you can take your favorite products on the go.

## Color-Coded Organization

Each bottle features a bold psychedelic color, so you can identify contents at a glance. Assign one color to your perfume, another to your essential oils, and a third to your travel toner.

## Shop With Confidence

Every bottle comes with a first-year replacement promise. If a bottle becomes compromised or leaks during its first year, contact MoYo Natural Labs and they will replace it.

## Get Your Set Today

Add this 3-pack to your cart and keep your beauty and wellness essentials organized, portable, and ready for every trip.
